title: Exclude fixed-clock Type B central-phase transfers (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact #7113 caller, all 104 fixed-clock transfers of a negative central phase from one rank-nine Type B idle to one larger even idle fail. The two jobs keep their roles and body masks, with every other operator fixed. Modular and independent exact rational checks agree on every pair, including 52 with disjoint masks. Zero cases remain unresolved.

The complete #7314 invoice prices 110,536 paid and 22,461 productive positions across 17 native copies. The optimistic pre-support upper is 0.22538900255587932 raw units for up to four disjoint transfers. No individual transfer survives. Simultaneous transfers could cancel defects even at disjoint clocks and remain outside the exclusion.

## Task and overlap

Round 56 of Discussion #7111. Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, #7314 head 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 and signed #7113 caller head 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The independently reproduced peer comparison is κ = 0.003646221436446. #7309 bounds pure signed demotion, #7296 bounds a merged one-child volume, #7295 studies fixed-contact lane capacity and #7315 checks even idle grouping. This package tests a phase move while retaining both jobs. The branch retains both published #7257 hosted-replay prerequisites with original authorship.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-type-b-central-phase-transfer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-type-b-central-phase-transfer --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, commit byte/mode/source authentication, Git-free export replay and six navigation tests passed locally. The package regenerates four deterministic receipts and controls byte-for-byte and rejects a corrupted caller. It authenticates the exact comparator’s four independent scientific stage receipts. Its hosted run was queued at admission. The stock full-history wrapper refused that shallow comparator checkout, and the exact ancestry and declared source pins passed separate checks.

## Credit

#7113 supplies the signed caller, #7314 and #7277 the comparator lineage and #7298 the directed arithmetic. #7309, #7296, #7295, #7315 and #1252 supply the related demotion, child-volume, idle-grouping and rank-repartition precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed surrounding interval or a simultaneous transfer needs its own two-sided projector test and complete price. A surviving route also needs a uniform signed multi-stage binding and dirty-data restoration.
